author: Jimmy Parker
title: VIDEO: Two Black Men Chase, Knock Down White Man Outside Bronx Deli, Stab Him Multiple Times
text:
Violence Erupts Outside a Bronx Deli
A 42-year-old man was stabbed multiple times Tuesday morning outside a deli at 3053 Villa Avenue in the Bronx, between Bedford Park Boulevard and East 204th Street. According to local reporting, FDNY and EMS received a 911 call at 9:17 a.m. about a stabbing at that location. The victim was taken to St. Barnabas Hospital in Belmont. Early reports did not give his condition. Police arrested two men after the incident. A witness told Norwood News that the victim had a bike and that a fight broke out after a verbal dispute. That witness said the argument grew from two people into three, then turned violent when the victim was stabbed in the stomach and leg.
Video Shows the Attack Unfold
Surveillance footage obtained by News 12 reportedly shows two men chasing the victim, knocking him to the ground, and then stabbing him. That is not a “misunderstanding.” That is street violence in broad daylight, the kind regular people have to live around while politicians hold press conferences about everything except the obvious. One local resident described the suspects as known “trouble makers” and said, “It’s not the first time.” That short quote says plenty. People in these neighborhoods often know exactly who causes trouble, but the system too often acts surprised when trouble shows up again.
https://x.com/penguinsix/status/2073530793863823375?s=46
The Media Double Standard Gets Noticed
The story also drew attention online because of how some national media outlets choose which incidents deserve wall-to-wall concern. The account End Wokeness compared the Bronx stabbing coverage to the recent uproar over a viral photo involving Patriot Front demonstrators riding the DC Metro near a Black woman. In that Metro case, no attack was reported, yet plenty of media oxygen was spent trying to turn the image into a national sermon. Apparently, a subway photo can become a five-alarm media event, while an actual stabbing outside a deli may struggle to get the same level of concern. Funny how the outrage machine always seems to need fresh batteries when the facts do not fit the preferred script.
https://x.com/EndWokeness/status/2074656088973058191?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw
Public Safety Should Not Depend on Politics
This case should be treated first as a serious violent crime, not as a political prop. A man was stabbed multiple times, and the people living near that deli deserve safety, order, and honest reporting. If officials have video, witnesses, and arrests, then the public deserves clear answers on charges and accountability. Conservatives have been saying this for years: law and order is not a slogan, it is the basic deal citizens expect from government. When the press spends more time clutching pearls over a nonviolent political image than covering attacks that leave people bleeding in the street, Americans notice. They are not asking for drama. They are asking for equal standards, real consequences, and streets where a morning argument does not end with an ambulance ride.
WE’D LOVE TO HEAR YOUR THOUGHTS! PLEASE COMMENT BELOW.
JIMMY
